hero.title: MangyTour: AI guide to Mangystau
hero.subtitle: A digital platform that unites nature, culture and intelligent recommendations.

problem.title: The problem
problem.paragraph1: Mangystau is home to unique canyons, sacred rock formations and coastal landscapes, yet many of them are poorly visible on the tourist map.
problem.paragraph2: Information is fragmented, multilingual guides are scarce, navigation is complex. Without a digital ecosystem, the region’s economic and cultural potential remains underused.

solution.title: The solution
solution.intro: MangyTour is an AI-powered mobile app and Telegram guide. It aggregates routes, provides accurate data, personalized suggestions and convenient navigation.

ai.title: AI capabilities
items: 🤖 Personal route generator (nature, culture, extreme, spiritual)
🌦️ Context-aware tips based on weather and conditions

solution.conclusion: MangyTour delivers not just routes, but emotions and deep experiences.

impact.title: Impact
items: 👥 New jobs for locals: guides, artisans, youth
📉 Lower unemployment and higher civic activity
💻 Digitized tourism aligned with global standards
🚀 Stronger regional brand, more investment and visitors

cta.title: Let’s grow MangyTour together!
cta.subtitle: Get in touch about partnership, investment or volunteering.

hero.heading: Discover the wonders of Mangystau
hero.description: Canyons, mountains and the Caspian coast — top spots, practical tips and trip planning in one place.

about.title: About the project
about.content: TravelX Mangystau is your guide to the region’s most exciting natural and cultural places. We share practical advice, routes and helpful information.

1.title: Bozzhyra Canyon
1.excerpt: Dramatic cliffs and salt flats — perfect for sunrise photography.
1.fullDescription: Bozzhyra Canyon is one of Mangystau’s most spectacular natural wonders. Formed over millions of years, its unique landforms captivate with layered geology, striking rock formations and sweeping vistas.

details.bestTime: May–September, early morning or late evening

2.title: Sherkala Mountain
2.excerpt: Iconic mountain and ancient routes with breathtaking views.
2.fullDescription: Sherkala is a symbol of Mangystau. The mountain’s distinctive shape is surrounded by legends and revered by locals as a sacred landmark.

3.title: Coastal Routes
3.excerpt: Hidden bays of the Caspian Sea and traditional fishing villages.
3.fullDescription: Explore hidden coves, ancient settlements and traditional fishing villages along the stunning Caspian coastline — a blend of natural beauty and cultural heritage.
